claim_scope: Strict SAP version 1 framing, SDP field normalization, and the announcement shape PipeWire's SAP module emits.
allowed_evidence: Sanitized implementation specification supplied for this task on 2026-09-12.
Public SAP and SDP protocol syntax.

Public PipeWire source src/modules/module-rtp-sap.c (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PipeWire/pipewire/master/src/modules/module-rtp-sap.c), fetched 2026-09-28, SHA-256 405e0c72f7a86b946230b9c14594656e5ab3ef3253734e6638a0736520c027c1.
transformation: Constructed a minimal deterministic announcement with an eight-byte authentication field, two IPv4 connection addresses, linear PCM rtpmap, decimal packet time, media clock, PTP reference, direction, and an origin marker.
limitations: These synthetic packets do not establish natural announcement compatibility, network discovery, receiver subscription, or media transport. The PipeWire-shaped packet follows public source; it is not a capture from any reporter or host.

pipewire-shaped-announcement.bin.transformation: Constructed from the line order and attribute forms in make_sdp and send_sap: LF line endings, session-level connection, media-level i= channel list, a=recvonly, a=source-filter, a=ptime, a=ts-refclk, a=mediaclk:direct, a=tool and a=type. Addresses, session identity, host name, user name and version are synthetic.
